title: fix(metadata-protocol): a compile-cache bucket opened by a counter move keeps the row sets read within the last bound
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D7K4emLL9dNcp4rQPn22Dw)_

Fixes #34554

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 元数据编译缓存(#34494 加的)在注册表计数器变动、开新桶时，不再一律清掉 `sys_metadata` 行缓存;只要这批行是在一个周期(默认 30 秒)内读到的就留着，新桶第一个周期在「这批行读到后满一个周期」时结束。行更旧才照旧清掉。
- **为什么改：** 契约复审 S5 怀疑的情况实测成立：会把存储行注册回注册表的内核上，每次列表读都会推动 `registry.revision`,哪怕注册的东西没变。每次推动都清掉行缓存，于是列表读和其后的单项读全回到数据库。「列表 + 单项」交替时，缓存开着每轮 3 次库读，关着 1 次;三个单项时 7 对 3。
- **风险与回滚：** 新鲜度上限不变：任何答案里的行都不超过一个周期旧，同一进程内的写入照旧立即清缓存。修后同样的交替读与关缓存时一样多。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-compile-cache.ts` 里开新桶的那段(`readThroughMetaCompileCache`),再看 `meta-overlay-cache.ts` 新增的 `readOverlayCacheGenerationSince`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/meta-compile-cache.test.ts`,预期 40 个全过。
- **需要你做的：** 不需要。区线程审核后合入。

## What changes

- `meta-overlay-cache.ts`: the per-engine generation state now records `since`, the wall-clock time the current generation began (set wherever the generation moves: a `sys_metadata` write at the middleware seam, a non-`write` epoch bump, `retireMetaOverlayCache`). Every row set held under the current generation was read at or after it, because an entry is stamped with the generation its read started under. New export `readOverlayCacheGenerationSince(engine)`.
- `meta-compile-cache.ts`: a bucket opened by a counter move (`registry.revision`, `objectRevision`, the metadata service's `revision`) no longer always retires the row cache. When the row cache's generation began less than one bound ago, the rows are kept and the bucket's first bound ends at `since + ttl`, so no answer carries a row more than one bound old, which is the bound the retirement was there to give. When it began a bound or more ago, the bucket retires the rows as before and its first bound is a full one. Confirmations are unchanged: each still retires the row cache. The module header says the same.

## Tests

- New group in `meta-compile-cache.test.ts`, on a harness option `hydrationMovesRevision` (the double's `registerItem` and `registerObject` move the registry's counters, as every public write of the real `SchemaRegistry` does through `registry-revision.ts`): a list read of three stored objects, then 1 or 3 item reads, four rounds. Store reads per round with the cache on equal the cache-off reads, and after the first round they are only the item count. Each round asserts the list read moved `registry.revision` (non-vacuity).
- **Forced test edit, named:** the existing pin "a counter move retires the row cache: a peer's write the row cache predates is in the new bucket's answer" asserted the old rule. It is replaced by two pins: (1) within one bound of the rows' read, a counter move keeps them (no row read from the store, the earlier answer served) and the peer's write is in the answer once that bound ends; (2) once the rows are more than a bound old, a counter move retires them and the peer's write is in the new bucket's answer with no confirmation reading (the old pin's assertion, at the age the rule now names).
- [L1 R1, rework 1] `the bucket a counter move opens ends its first bound one bound after the kept rows were read, not one bound after the move`: rows read at T, a peer's write and a counter move at T + 20 s, the earlier answer still served with no row read, and the peer's write in the answer at T + 30.001 s, less than one bound after the move. Ablation of the mutant L1 named (`confirmedUntil = now + ttlMs` in the keep arm): this pin red, `expected 'Widget' to be 'Gadget'`, 1 of 40; restored, 40 of 40.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): the keep branch disabled (`if (false && …)`), 3 of 39 red: the keep pin (`expected 'Gadget' to be 'Widget'`) and both alternation pins (`[3,3,3,3]` against `[3,1,1,1]`, `[7,7,7,7]` against `[7,3,3,3]`); restored, all green.

## Reading (the card's acceptance)

The double's store, three stored `object` rows, `getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` then N `getMetaItem` reads, per round, store reads counted at the engine:

| | round 1 | rounds 2 to 5 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| before, cache on, N=1 | 3 | 3 each (list rows, the item's rows, one `findOne`) |
| before, cache off (`OS_METADATA_COMPILE_CACHE_TTL_MS=0`), N=1 | 3 | 1 each (the `findOne`) |
| before, cache on, N=3 | 7 | 7 each |
| before, cache off, N=3 | 7 | 3 each |
| after, cache on, N=1 / N=3 | 3 / 7 | 1 / 3 each |

"Cache off" is the uncached path the compile cache's own `0` setting gives (ADR-0156 D6), not a build of `main` before #34494; the one `findOne` per item read is the same in every row and is not this cache's.
